title: Surreal Eye Dreamscape
description: A vibrant surreal painting depicts a giant purple eye forming the base of a fantastical landscape. A skeletal figure in a yellow suit sits on the lower eyelid next to a treehouse, a floating purple crystal, a steaming coffee cup, and a distant windmill under golden sunbeams.
prompt: A highly detailed surreal fantasy landscape painting featuring a massive purple eye as the central element, with a skeletal character in a bright yellow suit and blue bandana sitting on the lower eyelid, a treehouse growing from the eye, a floating purple crystal island with plants, a small wooden table with a steaming teal coffee cup and a swirled pastry, a winding path leading to a wooden windmill on a green hill, beams of golden sunlight streaming through a lush forest canopy, small boat on a stream, glowing particles, in a vibrant whimsical style
